title: Delhi-NCR weather: Dust storm hits Noida, Ghaziabad, East Delhi - News24Online
full_text:
Delhi-NCR weather: Noida and Greater Noida witnessed a sudden change in weather on Friday afternoon as strong, dusty winds swept across the region, briefly turning the sky dark. However, the weather cleared within minutes. The sudden change brought relief from the intense afternoon sunshine and heat. The strong winds also slowed down traffic as vehicles struggled to move at their usual speed on the roads.
Meanwhile, the monsoon has almost completely withdrawn from Uttar Pradesh, and weather conditions are changing during the second week of October. According to the latest weather forecast mentioned in the report, most parts of the state are likely to experience dry and mainly clear weather on October 10.
UP Weather Forecast: Sunshine Likely on October 10
Uttar Pradesh is expected to see bright sunshine during the day on October 10, which may lead to a slight rise in temperatures. The maximum temperature is likely to remain around 30 degrees Celsius, while the minimum temperature may stay near 22 degrees Celsius.
People may experience mild coolness during the morning and night. However, strong sunshine during the afternoon could make conditions warm and humid in some areas. The changing weather may bring some relief from the recent heat, although daytime temperatures are expected to remain relatively high.
Strong Winds May Bring a Change in Weather
Winds are expected to blow mainly from the east at a speed of around 7 miles per hour, according to the forecast provided in the report. No warning for heavy rainfall or severe weather conditions has been mentioned for the day.
The dry weather is expected to provide relief to commuters and people planning outdoor activities. However, residents should remain alert to sudden changes in weather, especially after the dust storm witnessed in Noida and Greater Noida.
Farmers and other residents are advised to plan their daily activities according to changing temperatures and local weather conditions. With the monsoon almost over in Uttar Pradesh, clear skies and warm afternoons are likely to remain a key feature of the weather during this period.
